name: Church of South India

citations.locator: Church of South India, member profile
citations.excerpt: The Church of South India was inaugurated in 1947, after thirty years of union negotiations between the South India United Church - the combined body of Presbyterians and Congregationalists - the Anglican dioceses in South India and the South Indian districts of the Methodist Church.

facts.value: United church accepting the historic episcopate in constitutional form, on the basis of the Lambeth Quadrilateral.

citations.excerpt: The basis of the constitution is the Lambeth Quadrilateral, the historical episcopate being accepted in a constitutional form.

facts.value: Inaugurated in 1947 by a union of the South India United Church (Presbyterians and Congregationalists), the Anglican dioceses in South India and the South Indian Methodist districts. One of its dioceses is in Sri Lanka.

citations.excerpt: Out of the 22 dioceses of the CSI one is in Jaffna, Sri Lanka.
